functions.evidence: Runtime sandbox initialization calls this import with name rd, a stack buffer and length16. The original wrapper forwards name/buffer/length to PE_parse_boot_argn_internal using BootArgs.CommandLine+0x6c and string mode TRUE (w4=1), matching pinned Apple pexpert/gen/bootargs.c PE_parse_boot_arg_str. Its tail target is already paired to that internal parser. The native board wrapper preserves the interface and adds PE_builtin_boot_args fallback, explaining its different shape. Hardware panic and exact chain evidence: sandbox-bootarg-binding-20261031.json.

Paired original and native IOCPU vtables identify the same virtual method slot; pinned Apple iokit/Kernel/IOCPU.cpp defines its ABI. Original get/set wrappers null-check and tail-call the already identified IORegistryEntry implementation; serializeProperties copies/serializes the property dictionary. The native methods preserve CPU-state behavior. See iocpu-property-bindings-20261031.json; runtime getProperty call at IORegistryEntry::init+0x1cc hit the retained AppleARMPlatform vtable slot with discriminator0x82eb.

data.evidence: Both real images name this vnodeop_desc vnop_getnamedstream through their chained pointer at +8. Scalar flags, five argument offsets, terminated vnode-argument-offset array and null transports match. vdesc_offset is a 32-bit first field at +0 on both sides; vfs_op_init assigns the native canonical object its runtime operation index. This binds the pointer identity rather than copying or zeroing a descriptor. Detailed ABI and runtime evidence: apfs-vnop-descriptor-bindings-20261031.json.

Exact original constant pointer slot points to original IOCPU::gMetaClass already identified in the actual map. The unique native IOCPU::metaClass pointer slot points to the unique native IOCPU::gMetaClass. Apple OSDefineMetaClassWithInit declares const OSMetaClass * const Class::metaClass = &Class::gMetaClass. Bind the variable slot, not the object, because consumers load through the slot. Detailed two-load ABI and observed IOHID cast evidence: metaclass-slot-bindings-20261101.json.
